patterns: APPSC asks Andhra-specific single facts: C.P. Brown's Telugu-English dictionary, V. Veeranna helped Cotton, Peddapuram = Vatsavayi, Chittoor district 1911.
Statement pairs on revenue terms recur: Moturpha is NOT a salt tax (loom/occupation tax); Peshcush = revenue from zamindars; Zamindari in Circars vs Ryotwari in Datta mandalalu.
Chronology items: Guntur 1788 > Padmanabham 1794 > Ryotwari in Madras > zamindari abolition.
App MCQs closely follow the Andhra framing but add judicial/police and current-affairs items; a few rely on disputed notes (Board of Revenue 1794, Anantapur HQ).
